strings.who.p: 很少有地方注明接待谁。如果筛选后什么都没有，就关掉筛选——他们可能仍然会接待你。

notes: High-quality, plain and warm translation already; few fixes. Fixed: note.wrong ('别的地方有错' meant 'another place is wrong'), filters 'too narrow' (太少→太窄), guess.p wording, open-now filter label made consistent with 开着/关着, ui.away 距离→远 (it follows the distance), shelter category unified to 收容所, Wi‑Fi spelling unified, plan text clarified, 'for' dictionary: orphan/juvenile/less stigmatising wording for drug users, outreach sub-category. Chinese has only the 'other' plural category: #other set to the (unchanged) base for all 10 plural keys.
